# QA-only migration ledger rows accepted for a production hotfix.
#
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS
# The shared QA database (bpybjrjenwccowvtrevu) carries the branch/access feature
# history that was developed there. A production hotfix starts from the production
# lineage and must not import or apply those unrelated migrations. The migration
# verifier therefore checks the direction that matters for a release:
#
#   * every file in THIS commit is recorded in QA with the hash it was applied with;
#   * no file is pending or changed; and
#   * every QA-only row is listed here, explicitly reviewed.
#
# The check fails on an unlisted QA-only row and on a stale entry below, so this
# exception cannot grow unnoticed. It does not apply anything to QA or production.
#
# Reviewed against CI run 41904652758 / main bfd7df2 on 2026-11-04.
